cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Orders from the Shadows
cards.instruction: Hide that you set the problem in motion while quietly directing how everyone responds.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll get the wedding bookings back under control. Please reassure the couples while I rebuild the dates.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The cancellation log has your initials.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Keep that screen here. You choose how to explain the replacement dates; I'll handle the log so we don't confuse anyone.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We can re-enter dates as new bookings, or press Restore All. That button emails them who canceled.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: New bookings, then. I'll stay and read every date to you at your pace. You take the keyboard; I'll manage the list. They need their weddings back, not a cancellation history.
